cases.name: Rossana Miliani
cases.caseStatus: NO BODY CASE; NO ONE CHARGED / PROSECUTED
cases.narrative:
She was last seen at the Ramada Inn hotel in the vicinity of the 100 block of Painttown Road in Cherokee, NC. She was from Miami, FL and was vacationing in NC at the time.

Miliani spoke of plans to hike the Appalachian Trail. She called her father from the hotel that day and told him she was going hiking. She sighted in Bryson City, North Carolina, the day of her disappearance; she rented a storage space at Ye Olde Mini Storage on River Street. Miliani has not been seen since.
